text:
maria: Heads up — authz dashboard showing most recent hour as 'org:unknown'. Quotas are attributed to orgs but traces still have service-account IDs. Anyone else seeing attribution mismatch?

sam: Yup saw that during the canary. Seems like the exchange fallback path is dropping the project claim when proxying.

tess: Is this related to the telemetry sampling tweak we pushed last week (reduce org cardinality)?

infra-bot: deploy: auth-exchange-service v1.12.3 -> prod at 2024-06-12T09:22:00Z :rocket:

alex: Quick paste of a raw header capture from the failing route: 
```json
{
  "x-request-id": "r-9a7f",
  "x-org-id": null,
  "x-project-id": null,
  "x-service-account": "sa-123-prod"
}
```

jeff: We did change telemetry sampling to hash and drop low-frequency orgs to reduce cardinality. That logic runs before attribution enrichment for high-QPS routes (to keep costs down). Looks like this path falls into that bucket.

lisa: If sampling runs before enrichment, the console will never see the org for those requests. UX suggestion: show an "effective identity" column that displays the best-known attribution (priority: project > service-account > org) and annotate which step was sampled/trimmed.

ops: Heads-up — if we re-run enrichment before sampling we'll increase telemetry volume. Ballpark estimate: ~20% extra events and storage for 30d. Need budget sign-off.

sam: Alternative: keep sampling but emit a tiny attribution flag for every sampled event (e.g., "had_org": true/false) so console can infer missing pieces without full identity payload. That should be cheaper.

maria: I like the smaller flag approach. Product/console can then show "partial attribution" state with tooltip explaining limits.

tess: How do we show rollout status? We should avoid surprising customers who see quota usage jump when we change attribution.

lisa: Rollout plan idea: 1) Add telemetry flag + console UI toggle (off by default) 2) Enable internally for dev+internal orgs 3) Gradual opt-in for customers via console with clear copy about quota implications 4) After 30 days, evaluate.

jeff: I'll prototype the flag in the pipeline; need an RFC for storage impact and a toggle in the config service.

ops: Please include metrics for cost delta, and a circuit-breaker if ingestion grows >2x.

maria: I'll write the UX copy and file the infra ticket. Assigning owners: Maria (UX & comms), Jeff (telemetry pipeline), Lisa (console toggle), Sam (routing/claim fix).

alex: Added a short reproduction snippet in the ticket (headers capture + failing route).

sam: One more ask — can console show a per-route "attribution confidence" badge? Low/med/high. That'd make it obvious.

lisa: Yes, confidence badge + tooltip with last-enriched-timestamp.

maria: OK team — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to lock the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:

ops: noted. I'll prep cost numbers. :+1:

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2981 "telemetry: attribution flag + console effective_identity UI"

maria: Thanks — closing loop here.
